notes: Final planned regression-hardening build for the document/training workflow. Validation found four older approved Toolbox Talks without a refresher schedule and eight related active assignments without renewal values; these were backfilled to the existing 12-month recurring TBT default, with instructor-led retained for both initial and refresher delivery. Database enforcement now prevents an approved TBT without a schedule or with a non-instructor method. Training-pack decision privacy is tightened so ordinary users can read only decisions for packs actually assigned to them; Managers/Admins retain the full view. The linked-change rule 'New version required' now pauses completion/attendance/retraining on the affected old SSW/TBT until the replacement is approved, with database triggers preventing client-side bypass. The UI shows this as a red update-required block. Replacement lineage is also recognised in the linked-impact/change-control display so an approved replacement resolves the original follow-up instead of being treated as a brand-new unresolved item. Post-migration checks show zero approved TBTs missing schedules, zero active assignments missing renewal data, zero invalid active source-training records, zero report-viewer training assignments and zero current control blocks in live data. Supabase migration final_training_regression_hardening_v21068 applied. No PTW code was changed.
